card.name: USP and USP-NF abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last letter of the abbreviation USP (or NF in USP-NF) after "US" or "USP-N", in preparation, dilution and storage directions.

modes.label: USP after a diluent
modes.description: The P of USP right after a diluent name such as Sodium Chloride Injection or Purified Water.

modes.label: USP in other phrases
modes.description: The P of USP before a container type or storage term.

modes.label: USP-NF
modes.description: The F of NF in the compendium name USP-NF.

card.plain: It fires on the final letter of the pharmacopeia abbreviation USP (or USP-NF) in mixing and storage directions.
